comments:
The author uses some Sanskrit words rather than their Tibetan equivalents (e.g., bud+d+ha, loka).
The passage on "purpose and connection" (dgos 'brel) (see (ID:5146), fol. 5b) is quasi identical (albeit a bit shorter) to the one in a Śikṣāsamuccaya commentary (ID:4649) also by "byang chub skyabs," lending support to the author of both works being the same.
The reference to "rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi seng ge" ex066032025-12-1917-23-04 - likely Phya pa (ID:3831) - suggest the author was his student, 'Jad pa Byang chub skyabs.
